newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen moving in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen moving in narrow range.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to move in a narrow range on Thursday as investors waited for more local commercial banks to cut interest rates and on the formation of a new cabinet, brokers said.
The SET index rose 1.09 point to 959.23 at the finish on thin 2.8 billion baht turnover on Wednesday.

"Investors are waiting for local banks to cut interest rates and for the new government," said Busaba Kunasirin of Chao Phya Finance. Krung Thai Bank has said it would cut prime lending rate by 25 basis points to 13.00 percent, effective December 2.
